questionDefinition:
<quiz><question type="stack"><name><text>Fraction display comparison</text></name><questionvariables><text>m:matrix([-1/4,-2/3],[1/4,2/3]);
a:sconcat("\\(",tex1(m),"\\)");
b:stack_disp(m,"i");
c:stack_disp(unary_minus_sort(m),"i");
d:castext("{@m@}");
tex2new(s):=stack_disp(s,"i");
tex2Lnew(L):=block([s:"\\(",k],for k:1 thru length(L) do s:sconcat(s,if stringp(L[k]) then L[k] else stack_disp(L[k],"")," "),sconcat(s,"\\)"));
prod:tex2Lnew([m,"=",m]);
safe:stack_disp(-(x+1)/3,"i");
</text></questionvariables><questiontext><text><p>direct: {@m@}</p><p>tex1: {@a@}</p><p>stack_disp: {@b@}</p><p>sorted: {@c@}</p><p>castext: {@d@}</p><p>product: {@prod@}</p><p>needed grouping: {@safe@}</p></text></questiontext><generalfeedback><text /></generalfeedback><questionnote>fraction comparison</questionnote></question></quiz>
